name: Model bench
author: Mail Triage
description: Benchmark the configured LLM the way this app uses it: classification quality on a frozen subset of the v2 benchmark, JSON reliability, injection resistance, latency - and a verdict against reference models. Ask the assistant to "benchmark my model".

default_scope.description: Default scope for a new run: 'quick' (14 probes) or 'standard' (28 probes).

user_name.description: Name used in the classification prompt (blank = 'the user'). Match your Settings name for a faithful run.

tools.name: model_bench
tools.description: Benchmark the configured LLM: frozen classification cases (category accuracy, needs_reply, JSON validity, injection resistance), endpoint compatibility, and drafting/rules/summary probes - scored against reference models. Runs in slices: call again with no arguments to continue; reset=true starts over; scope 'quick' or 'standard'.

scope.description: Suite size; defaults to the plugin's setting (standard).

reset.description: Discard any run in progress and start a fresh sweep.

assistant.when_to_use: Use when the user asks to benchmark, test or vet the configured model, asks whether their model is good enough, or wants a quality/speed score for this app's model.
